column1: # Datasets follow SpatialEx Supplementary Table 1 (H&E-to-Omics + Panel Integration sections).
# Each Xenium *_outs.zip already contains: cells.csv.gz, cell_feature_matrix.h5, transcripts.parquet,
# H&E + alignment CSV are downloaded separately because they live outside the outs.zip.
#   - hColon: outs.zip is the "Add_on" sample; the post-Xenium H&E + alignment csv only
#     ship with the matched "Base" sample (same physical section, different panel scope).
#   - hSkin: outs.zip is from xeniumranger reprocessing (1.7.0); H&E/alignment from the
#     base 1.6.0 release of the same section.
#   - IDC_Big: 10x only provides the un-aligned H&E (he_unaligned_image.ome.tif). The
#     imagealignment.csv lets you transform it onto the Xenium morphology frame.
